name: 80239 · Denver, CO
findings: ZIP 80239 (Denver) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80239 (Denver) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 21 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
